title: 美联储官员保罗森：利率政策保持开放态度
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, you want a reaction function. We are getting it not necessarily from Kevin Warsch, the chairman, but Anna Paulson, the president of the Philadelphia Fed, is out with an essay
segments.zh: 你希望看到政策反应机制。我们不一定从主席凯文·沃什那里得到，但费城联储主席安娜·保尔森今早发表了一篇文章，阐述了她对经济的看法。

segments.en: this morning explaining what she thinks of the economy. She's still in the whole camp, but she is growing more concern, citing subdued wage growth, elevated mortgage rates, and muted
segments.zh: 她仍属于鸽派阵营，但担忧加剧，指出工资增长疲软、抵押贷款利率高企以及房地产市场低迷。

segments.en: housing markets. All of this information, she says, points to current policy being mildly restrictive.
segments.zh: 她表示，所有这些信息都表明当前政策具有轻度限制性。

segments.en: The other possibility, however, is that current policy is not restricted enough to deliver our target rate of 2% inflation. The most compelling evidence for this view,
segments.zh: 然而，另一种可能是当前政策限制性不足，无法实现2%的通胀目标。支持这一观点最有力的证据是，

segments.en: straightforward, inflation has been above the target for more than five years, persistently elevated inflation suggests more restrictive policy may be needed. She says, stripping out tariffs
segments.zh: 简单来说，通胀已高于目标超过五年，持续高企的通胀表明可能需要更紧缩的政策。她说，剔除关税和能源因素后，

segments.en: and energy, Paulson sees underlying inflation somewhere between 2.4 and 2.8%, and that is the metric that she is using. If you want the reaction function, she wants to see months plural of
segments.zh: 保尔森认为潜在通胀在2.4%到2.8%之间，这是她使用的指标。如果你想要反应机制，她希望看到连续几个月

segments.en: improving inflation data and signs that pressures from tariffs, energy, and AI are contained.
segments.zh: 通胀数据改善，以及关税、能源和人工智能带来的压力得到控制的迹象。

segments.en: If instead underlying inflation remains stubbornly elevated, the passage of time without progress would itself signal that more restrictive policy is needed. She wants to see months
segments.zh: 如果潜在通胀仍然顽固高企，那么时间流逝而无进展本身将表明需要更紧缩的政策。她希望看到连续几个月

segments.en: of declining inflation, and we will get two inflation reports before the next Fed meeting, so she could be lined up if we don't see declines to vote yes for a rate increase.
segments.zh: 通胀下降，而在下一次美联储会议之前我们将有两份通胀报告，因此如果我们看不到下降，她可能会投票支持加息。
